Authorization._comment: Point Authority at your Keycloak realm once CIMD is enabled (--features=cimd). Keycloak doesn't support RFC 8707 resource indicators, so CIMD clients only get this Audience in their access token if you add a client-scope audience mapper for it (Included Custom Audience = Audience below) and the Client requests that scope - see docs/keycloak-setup.md. Audience defaults to Server:ResourceUri since that's what the mapper's audience value should be.
